pages.title: It Offered, For Once
pages.text: You didn't have to ask. Mid-riddle, without preamble, it simply told you where to look - as if it had been waiting for the eyes-revealed to settle before it bothered.

pages.title: Where To Look
pages.text: Somewhere in the Warped Hollow, roughly X: 300, Z: -200. It won't be buried like the rest of what's out there - you should see it before you're standing on top of it.
